### Added

- **velta.cc/join invite links.** Invites are now shared as `velta.cc/join/?…` links by default — the landing page on the site personalizes the invitation, shows the scan-to-transfer QR, and deep-links into the app. Delta Chat mirror links and pasted links still work everywhere.
- **Cryptex.** A second provider for large files next to Lufi, so a big attachment can fall back when its first host is unreachable.

### Fixed

- **Images that never appeared.** A picture in a chat could stay an empty reserved box for the rest of the session when its decode finished while another chat was open. Cached rows now heal themselves on return — restart or forwarding no longer needed.
- **Chat switching on Android, part two.** Scheduler interrupts no longer queue behind an IO restart, so a background reconnect can't hold chat opens and sends hostage (the deep fix for the "won't open for minutes" stalls).

### Changed

- **Message sheet and menu.** A Firefox-style three-column action grid, delete confirms inline, a full-height emoji picker, and a clearer drag handle.
- **Chatmail core 2.66.0.** Marking messages seen and queueing read receipts happen in one transaction, and the IMAP loop avoids full table scans. The long-announced removal of the legacy `configured_addr` config landed — Velta switched to its own send pin in advance.
- Diagnostics logs strip CI build paths, and the PWA keeps the "Velta was updated" toast until you actually reload, with browser-only controls hidden properly.

### Under the hood

- The wasm patch series is rebased onto 2.66.0 (locks re-pinned) for the browser build that ships with this release.
